name: AFW C2 pending GET native TOOL one-use
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - lab/afw-c2-pending-get-20261118-native-tools1
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  c2-pending-get-native-tools1:
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'tokenizartinfo-ops/agent-friendly-web' &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/lab/afw-c2-pending-get-20261118-native-tools1' &&
      github.event.head_commit.message == 'AFW-C2-PENDING-GET-NATIVE-TOOLS1-ONEUSE-20261118' &&
      github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 7
    steps:
      - name: Anchor the job time bound
        shell: bash
        run: |
          printf 'AFW_B2_JOB_START_MS=%s\n' "$(/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic_ns() // 1000000)')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '22.23.4'
      - name: Install the frozen dependency lock
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Run the isolated finite TOOL proposal
        run: node docs/superpowers/source-lab/c2-pending-get-native-tools1/run-pending-get-native-tools1.mjs
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: afw-c2-pending-get-native-tools1
          path: output/c2-pending-get-native-tools1.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
